newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo down again after cautious BZW comment.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo down again after cautious BZW comment.

text.p: Shares in Glaxo Wellcome Plc dropped for a second day on Friday, in further reaction to Thursday's cautious comment on the stock from analysts at BZW, dealers said.

Backtracking from Wednesday's near-record close of 12.77-1/2 stg, Glaxo shares were down 23p at 12.36 stg by 1401 GMT. On Thursday the stock dropped 18-1/2p after BZW turned neutral on the short-term outlook for the stock.

"If BZW is telling people to top-slice their holdings, in the short term they are probably right," said one dealer. "But if the stock comes back to 12.20 stg we will be in an area where people will start looking at them again."
Glaxo has been one of the top performing stocks in the FTSE 100 so far this year, rising more than 30 percent from the end of 1996.
